source.title: Team seats for sales managers
open_questions: Pricing and plans. Which plans include team seats and how seats are priced.
Maximum team size at general release.
Whether the weekly report can be sent to people outside the team.

verdict.reason: A new capability a user can name, with labelled beta proof.

claims.quote: a weekly team report breaks when one person builds it alone
Nadia runs a team of six reps.
She pastes it all into a sheet and builds the page at 9 pm on Sunday.
Each rep connects their own export once, on a refresh schedule the rep picks.
the manager sees one weekly report for the whole team that still reads in two minutes
Managers reported that building the weekly team page took 52 minutes before team seats and 11 minutes with them.
The beta group was self selected.
Team seats are in closed beta. General release is planned for February 24, 2027.
Team seats are in closed beta.
A manager invites reps, each rep connects their own pipeline export
Shown when an export is older than a week
A manager who wants numbers from five reps has to ask each rep for an export and combine them by hand.
A rep sees their own deals and the team summary, never another rep's deal notes.
A notice lists reps whose export is older than a week.
